crossRefs.note: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap,
that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous…
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and…
so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
Surely then you will lift up your face without spot; Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear:
Yahweh turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.
In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day…
Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job, and have seen the Lord in the…
But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.
They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’

translations.web: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
translations.bsb: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
translations.kjv: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
translations.asv: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh him families like a flock.
